name: tech-writer
description: Use when writing or substantively editing user-facing documentation: drafting a new page, rewriting or restructuring an existing one, adding a major section, or turning engineering material (PR descriptions, specs, release notes, rough notes) into docs. Writes clear, focused technical documentation following the Diataxis framework and Mecatl's canonical style guide. Use it even when the request doesn't mention writing quality; it governs how documentation gets written. Not for editorial review of finished work.
